description: February 20 birthday meaning: Aquarius or Pisces cusp, birthday number 2, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, February 20 is a cusp birthday: depending on the year, time and place of birth, the Sun is in Aquarius or Pisces. In numerology the day gives birthday number 2, while the Life Path also depends on the birth year. Many people born on cusp dates recognise something of both signs.

sections.heading: Personality of a February 20 birthday
paragraphs: February 20 usually sees the Sun in the first degree of Pisces, though a few years and birth times keep it in Aquarius. Read as a blend, it marries detached insight with deep feeling. Number 2, linked with sensitivity and partnership, emphasises the Piscean side: an attentive listener who often senses what others need before they say it.

By noon UTC on February 20, the Sun has normally reached roughly 1° of Pisces. That places the date in the Pisces decan that astrologers give to Neptune, the first of three. The Aquarius–Pisces cusp, around February 17 to February 20, joins two of the most idealistic signs in the zodiac. Born here, your Sun sign is set by year, hour and birthplace, because the Sun's entry into Pisces does not fall on the same day every year; a natal chart resolves it. Those who feel both are often described as imaginative humanitarians, combining Aquarius' ideas about how the world could be with Pisces' compassion for the people living in it. They may drift between detachment and deep feeling, and learn to use each when it helps.

sections.heading: Numerology of the February 20 birthday
paragraphs: A birthday on the 20th reduces as 2 + 0 = 2, giving a birthday number of 2. The 0 is often read as amplifying the 2, intensifying its sensitivity, diplomacy and emotional awareness. Those born on the 20th are frequently described as intuitive companions and natural team members, attuned to atmosphere and moods. They may pick up the feeling in a room before anyone has spoken. As a secondary number in the chart, the 20 tends to show in close relationships and group work. Protecting their own energy, and saying no kindly, is a recurring theme for this birthday.

Because the year enters the Life Path calculation, the same February 20 birthday leads to different paths across generations, among them 4 for 1980, 5 for 1990, 6 for 2000 and 7 for 2010. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11. The Life Path calculator does the reduction for any year.

sections.heading: February 20 in context: the season, Chinese zodiac and famous birthdays
paragraphs: February birthdays land in late winter for the northern hemisphere, when the light is visibly returning, and in late summer for the southern. The month moves from Aquarius into Pisces around February 18 or 19, from airy idealism to watery imagination. February is month 2 in numerology, a number of partnership, tact and sensitivity, which tends to give these birthdays a cooperative, quietly perceptive undertone. February 20 is the 51st day of the year. In most years Aries season is under way by March 21, 30 days after this birthday.

Chinese astrology is straightforward for a February 20 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies. February 20 is also the birthday of Kurt Cobain (1967), Gordon Brown (1951) and Sidney Poitier (1927).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is February 20?
faq.answer: February 20 is a cusp date. Between 1930 and 2030 the Sun is in Aquarius or Pisces on this date depending on the year, the time of birth and the time zone, and in most years at noon UTC it is in Pisces. The zodiac sign calculator settles it for a specific birth date.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on February 20?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On February 20 the Life Path is 11 in 1960, 3 in 1970, 4 in 1980, 5 in 1990, 6 in 2000, 7 in 2010 and 8 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 2 for everyone born on the 20th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on February 20?
faq.answer: By February 20 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on February 20?
faq.answer: Among the best-known people with a February 20 birthday are Kurt Cobain (1967), Gordon Brown (1951) and Sidney Poitier (1927). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
